title: Liquidity bot: Performance
description: Sub-page of the Liquidity bot board in the liquidity folder. The SPA's Performance tab, plus the pre-exporter native bot metrics as collapsed rows at the bottom.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: GCP project id — both the Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging queries take it directly.

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.description: Which process serves the liq_* metrics: the exporter sidecar (the default for now) or the bot's own /metrics. Pick bot to compare the two.

panels.description: The SPA header's connection light: is the bot process up and answering? The exporter source reads liq_up, which is 0 when the exporter cannot reach the bot's /health. The bot never emits liq_up, so the bot source reads the scrape's own up. '—' means the source is not reporting.

Deployed commit, from /health, cut to 7 characters like the SPA header. The stackdriver plugin runs a range query even for an instant target, so over the dashboard's 24h the previous commit is a second series and its name drew over this one. PromQL also keeps a stopped series for its 5m lookback, so topk on the sample timestamp keeps only the commit with the newest sample, over a 1m window.
Bot process uptime, from /health uptimeSeconds.
The SPA settings bar's Broker pill.
Equity rebalance target. The SPA pill also shows the band: target +/- liq_settings_equity_deviation.
USDC rebalance target. The SPA pill also shows the band: target +/- liq_settings_usdc_deviation.
Hedge execution threshold (settings bar 'Trigger').

panels.title: Detection latency
panels.description: p95, 24h. Fill on-chain → bot noticed. good ≤30s, warn ≤120s.

panels.title: Exposure window
panels.description: p95, 24h. Fill on-chain → hedge filled: how long capital stays exposed. good ≤60s, warn ≤300s.

panels.title: Errors (24h)
panels.description: ERROR-level log lines in 24h. good ≤0, warn ≤10. Money-at-risk lifecycle failures are broken out per event type in the 'Errors & warnings by module' table below.

panels.title: Oldest unhedged fill
panels.description: Age of the oldest on-chain fill not yet hedged. good ≤5m, warn ≤30m; '—' = nothing unhedged (the SPA shows 'none').

panels.title: Block lag
panels.description: Chain blocks the fill-detection checkpoint trails by. good ≤30, warn ≤300.
SPA secondary line: p50 detection latency.
SPA secondary line: fill sample count backing the detection latency percentiles.
SPA secondary line: p50 exposure-window latency.
SPA secondary line: hedge sample count backing the exposure-window percentiles.
SPA secondary line: WARN-level log lines in 24h.
SPA secondary line: money-at-risk lifecycle failure events in 24h (the 'Errors & warnings by module' table breaks these out by event type).
SPA secondary line: apalis job queues with a failed or killed job right now (instantaneous, not windowed) — the SPA folds killed into the same 'queue(s) failed' phrase.
SPA secondary line: on-chain fills still uncovered by a hedge, summed across symbols.
SPA secondary line: symbols with an open (unhedged) exposure — 0 is the SPA's 'all fills hedged'.
SPA secondary line: age of the current block-lag sample.
SPA secondary line: order-fill monitor poll ticks skipped (overrun) in 24h.

panels.title: Hedge cycle stages (p95, 24h)
panels.description: The SPA waterfall's aggregate form: p95 per stage. Per-cycle waterfalls live in the SPA.

panels.title: Latency percentiles over time — $stage
panels.description: p50/p90/p99 of the selected hedge stage, from the exporter's rolling 24h summary scraped once a minute.

panels.title: Errors & warnings by module (24h)
panels.description: The SPA's per-target error/warning counts. The Logs tab has the lines themselves. Click a module to jump to the Logs board pre-filtered on it (the SPA's 'logs →' button); sparkline cells are skipped as low-value/fiddly here.

panels.title: USDC rebalance stages (p95, 30d)
panels.description: Stage timings for USDC rebalances. From the server's stageSummary; per-operation waterfalls live in the SPA.

panels.title: Equity rebalance stages (p95, 30d)
panels.description: Stage timings for equity mints/redemptions.

panels.title: Dependency health (24h)
panels.description: Every RPC / broker operation: calls, errors, latency percentiles.

promQLQuery.expr: label_join(label_replace(liq_dependency_calls_24h{job=~"$source"}, "col", "calls", "", ""), "dep", " · ", "dependency", "operation") or label_join(label_replace(liq_dependency_errors_24h{job=~"$source"}, "col", "errors", "", ""), "dep", " · ", "dependency", "operation") or label_join(label_replace(liq_dependency_latency_ms{job=~"$source",quantile="p50"}, "col", "p50 ms", "", ""), "dep", " · ", "dependency", "operation") or label_join(label_replace(liq_dependency_latency_ms{job=~"$source",quantile="p95"}, "col", "p95 ms", "", ""), "dep", " · ", "dependency", "operation") or label_join(label_replace(liq_dependency_latency_ms{job=~"$source",quantile="max"}, "col", "max ms", "", ""), "dep", " · ", "dependency", "operation")

panels.title: CCTP attestation time
panels.description: Duration of the most recent CCTP attestation per rebalance kind, sampled once per scrape. The SPA can chart the full attestationTrend history for the selected range; this gauge only has 'last value at scrape time', so the line only accrues from whenever this panel started being scraped forward — a short/flat history here does not mean attestations were fast, it means the metric is young.

panels.title: Block lag over time
panels.description: The ingestion-health chart: how far fill detection trails the chain.

panels.title: Poll cycles (24h)
panels.description: Order-fill monitor poll cycles.

panels.title: Poll errors (24h)
panels.description: Failed poll cycles.

panels.title: Skipped ticks (24h)
panels.description: Poll ticks skipped (overrun).

panels.title: Poll duration percentiles
panels.description: The monitor's own cycle duration.

panels.title: Job queues
panels.description: The bot's apalis job queues (instantaneous whole-table counts, not windowed). killed or failed above zero is the SPA's critical Errors state.

panels.title: Hedge fill latency percentiles
panels.description: Wall-clock seconds from hedge order placement to confirmed fill. The app builds these as a metrics-rs summary (no explicit buckets), so the quantiles come straight off the {quantile=...} label rather than from histogram_quantile. This is the metrics-side view of the SPA's 'Latency percentiles over time' chart — that chart's per-stage waterfall (detection / decision / submission / execution) comes from the telemetry tables in SQLite and has no metric behind it.

panels.title: Hedge fill latency by symbol (1h average)
panels.description: Average seconds between placing a hedge and it filling, per symbol, derived from the summary's _sum / _count. Spikes mean capital sits exposed longer on that name.

panels.title: Broker errors per hour, by kind
panels.description: Alpaca API failures, split by kind (e.g. place_order_failed) and symbol. Empty is the healthy state.

panels.title: Hedge scans skipped, by reason
panels.description: Extended-hours buys the position scan dropped before enqueueing a hedge job, because reference-price resolution or crossing failed. Each one is an on-chain fill that did not get hedged on that pass.

panels.title: Hedges dead-lettered, by reason
panels.description: Hedge attempts the process gave up on: a permanent or retry-budget-exhausted pricing failure, or broker rate-limiting that outlived the reschedule budget. Anything here is an unhedged fill that needs a human.

panels.title: Which reference priced each extended-hours limit
panels.description: hedge_price_source_total by source (primary_quote / mark / delayed_sip_quote) and path (ordinary_extended / close_flatten). Shows which fallback legs are load-bearing — a rise in delayed_sip_quote means we are pricing off stale data.

panels.title: Attempts, by post-close gap reason
panels.description: Close-flatten hedge pricing attempts, by the post-close gap reason that triggered them.

panels.title: Blocked before submission, by reason
panels.description: Close-flatten attempts stopped before they reached the broker. close_time_unknown carries no symbol label; the rest are per symbol.

panels.title: Placements, by cross applied
panels.description: Limit orders priced and cleared for submission, bucketed to whole percent of cross. Counts attempts, not orders: a retried or re-driven placement of the same hedge counts again, and an attempt the broker later rejects still counts.

panels.title: Outcomes
panels.description: Terminal broker-state dispatches for close-flatten placements (filled / cancelled / failed). A placement can be observed again until its follow-up job commits the terminal aggregate transition, so treat these as dispatches rather than a strict order count.

panels.title: Data integrity & ingestion health (native bot metrics)
Ambiguous settlements (24h)
panels.description: Inventory settlements quarantined because one transaction emitted multiple OperatorDeposits or multiple OperatorWithdraws and the legs could not be safely paired. Each one is a held-back settlement.

panels.title: Unpaired settlement legs (24h)
panels.description: OperatorDeposit / OperatorWithdraw legs with no same-transaction counterpart in the batch.

panels.title: Unusable snapshot marks (24h)
panels.description: Nonzero equity balances captured with a missing or stale USD mark. These make the portfolio snapshot — and therefore the PnL replay in the SPA — incomplete for that interval.

panels.title: PnL ledger checkpoint lag
panels.description: How many events the PnL ledger's checkpoint trails the event store by. The PnL numbers themselves are computed by the backend from SQLite and are not exported — this gauge is the one PnL signal that reaches Grafana, and it answers 'is the PnL panel's input keeping up?'.

panels.title: Scrape health
panels.description: The Ops Agent's own view of the bot's /metrics endpoint: 1 = scraped successfully, 0 = the endpoint did not answer. Every other panel on this dashboard goes blank while this is 0, so check it first before concluding the bot is idle.

panels.title: Scrape duration and series count
panels.description: How long the scrape takes and how many series come back. A series count that collapses to near zero while up=1 means the bot restarted and its counters reset.

panels.title: Bot-gas redrives and PnL catch-up failures
panels.description: bot_gas_redrive_total: receipt-cost enqueue failures redriven instead of failing the triggering job. pnl_ledger_catch_up_failures_total: the PnL ledger failing to catch up to the event store. Both are self-healing retries — a steady rate means something underneath is not healing.
